always-evert-globe-desc: Play the globe transition even on devices where it is normally skipped to keep navigation fast. It may feel slower there. Reduced motion still turns it off.
always-evert-globe-reduced-off: Reduced motion is on, so the globe transition stays off and pages change as usual.
color-vision-desc: Retint success, warning and danger colours so they stay distinguishable. Status labels also carry their own icon, so nothing depends on colour alone.
custom-accent-desc: Pick any color — it is auto-adjusted to stay readable.
custom-accent-none: Nessun colore di accento personalizzato: viene usato il colore del tema.
eversion-level-all-desc: Links, buttons, and back and forward all play the eversion, with a globe that pops up where you tapped. The per-control press animation is separate and not affected.
eversion-level-all-desc-mini: Pages opened from the liquid globe play the full eversion. Any other link or button turns into a small globe right where you tapped, while the page changes without waiting.
eversion-level-globe-desc: Only pages you open from the liquid globe menu play the eversion. Everything else changes pages as usual. The per-control press animation is separate and not affected.
eversion-level-reduced-off: Reduced motion is on, so pages change as usual.
globe-cursor-canvas-desc: Over a game canvas the globe steps aside so the game’s own cursor shows.
globe-cursor-desc: Your pointer becomes a sphere that keeps turning itself inside out. Every change applies instantly — move the mouse to see it. Saved on this device.
globe-cursor-enabled-desc: Only on devices with a mouse or trackpad; touch screens are never affected.
globe-cursor-hide-native-desc: Off keeps your normal arrow with the globe following along.
globe-cursor-hotspot-desc: A small dot marks exactly where you will click, however far the globe lags.
globe-cursor-native-text-desc: Shows the I-beam while typing; the globe shrinks beside it.
globe-cursor-reduced: Reduced motion is on, so the globe holds still mid-eversion and the jelly, trail and sparkles are paused.
globe-cursor-roll-desc: The globe rolls like a ball in the direction you move.
nav-transition-equirect-desc: Una semplice griglia di latitudine e longitudine, lo srotolamento più elementare.
nav-transition-lambert-desc: Un disco equivalente centrato sulla pagina che stai lasciando.
nav-transition-mercator-desc: Il familiare srotolamento delle carte murali, stirato verso i poli.
nav-transition-peirce-desc: Il globo si apre in un quadrato che si può affiancare a mosaico.
nav-transition-random-desc: Ogni volta una mappa diversa, mai la stessa due volte di fila.
nav-transition-reduced-off: Reduced motion is on, so this transition is switched off and pages change as usual.
nav-transition-stereographic-desc: Il globo si appiattisce da un polo verso l’esterno fino a diventare un disco.
readable-font-desc: A more legible body font with looser spacing.
theme-desc: Daylight, Midnight, Alto contrasto e i temi selezionati.
tilt-denied: Motion access was declined. You can enable it in Safari settings.
tilt-effects-desc-jelly: La gelatina cattura la luce mentre inclini il dispositivo.
globe-navigation-only-hint: The liquid globe flattens and turns inside out when you choose a destination. Other links open immediately.
electric-arcs-desc: Piccole scintille tra le superfici e dove fai clic. Disattivale se lo sfarfallio ti dà fastidio.
electric-arcs-still-note: Il movimento della gelatina è impostato su Fermo, quindi per ora gli archi restano disattivati.
jelly-motion-desc: Quanto si muovono da sole le superfici di gelatina. Fermo mette in pausa ogni movimento ambientale e disattiva gli archi elettrici.
pause-ambient-motion: Metti in pausa il movimento ambientale
pause-ambient-motion-off: Impedisce alle superfici di gelatina di muoversi da sole.
jelly-motion-preview: Anteprima: passa il cursore o premi questa scheda per vedere come si muove.
